description: Small reference set of simple, independently verifiable claims in English, Swahili and Luganda. Used (a) offline in tests/test_pipeline.py with simulated evidence to check that wording is preserved and routing works, and (b) live by script/eval_multilingual.py to measure real behaviour.
review_status: The Swahili and Luganda sentences were drafted with AI assistance and have NOT yet been reviewed by native speakers. Please have a fluent speaker check them before treating results as a language-quality measure.
reference_note: Reference excerpts are short paraphrased facts used only as simulated evidence. The URLs are the public pages a journalist would use to confirm them; open them to verify.
